decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-aa8e5dfab881], is a one-line release-note title saying the Crossplane CLI now supports rendering default values from the XRD. It does not say whether this is opt-in or whether it changes existing render output. A changed default output would make this a behavior-change, not none. The PR description or CLI docs for PR #6161 are needed to show whether existing CLI output or behavior changes.
